shots.text: Умер один мужик, и попадает он на небо.
shots.prompt: a plump middle-aged clay man in a grey suit stands on fluffy white clouds looking around in confusion, soft golden light
shots.motion: the man looks around in confusion, clouds drift, camera slowly pushes in

shots.text: Встречает его апостол Пётр и говорит:
shots.prompt: close-up of a kind old clay Saint Peter with a white beard and huge golden keys at ornate golden gates, warm heavenly light
shots.motion: Saint Peter smiles and gestures welcomingly, camera slow push in

shots.text: «У тебя грехи и добрые дела ровно поровну. Выбирай сам: рай или ад».
shots.prompt: clay Saint Peter holding a giant golden balance scale that is perfectly level, the plump man in a suit staring at it, golden gates behind
shots.motion: the scale wobbles and settles level, the man scratches his head

shots.prompt: close-up of the plump clay man in a suit raising one finger with a sly grin, heaven clouds background
shots.motion: the man raises a finger and grins slyly, eyes glancing sideways

shots.prompt: the plump clay man in a suit walking down a long dark stone staircase into red glowing depths, tiny flames along the walls
shots.motion: the man walks down the stairs, flames flicker, camera follows from behind

shots.text: А там — пляж, солнце, музыка, столы ломятся от еды.
shots.prompt: a bright sunny clay beach party in hell with palm trees, cocktails, a buffet table piled with food, red devils dancing happily, disco lights
shots.motion: devils dance, lights sparkle, camera pans across the party

shots.text: Черти веселятся, все его обнимают, наливают.
shots.prompt: cheerful red clay devils hugging the plump man in a suit and handing him a huge cocktail, confetti in the air, party lights
shots.motion: devils hug the man and raise glasses, confetti falls

shots.text: Поднимается он в рай — тишина, ангелы на облаках играют на арфах.
shots.prompt: a serene clay heaven: white angels sitting quietly on clouds playing tiny harps, soft pastel light, very calm
shots.motion: angels gently pluck harps, clouds drift, camera slow drift

shots.prompt: the plump clay man in a suit yawning hugely on a cloud, bored, one angel playing a harp beside him
shots.motion: the man yawns wide and slumps, the angel keeps playing

shots.prompt: the plump clay man shaking hands with Saint Peter at the golden gates, pointing down with his other hand, confident grin
shots.motion: handshake, the man points down confidently

shots.prompt: the plump clay man happily skipping down the dark stone staircase into the red glow, arms spread
shots.motion: the man skips down the stairs, flames flicker

shots.text: А там — кипящая смола, крики, черти с вилами гонят грешников.
shots.prompt: a terrifying clay hell: bubbling black tar pits, screaming clay sinners, muscular red devils with pitchforks, harsh red light
shots.motion: tar bubbles, devils jab pitchforks, sinners flail, camera shakes slightly

shots.text: Мужик кричит: «Стойте! Вчера же был пляж и вечеринка!»
shots.prompt: close-up of the plump clay man in a suit screaming in shock, hands on his cheeks, red hellish light on his face
shots.motion: the man screams and grabs his cheeks, eyes wide

shots.prompt: close-up of a huge smug clay Lucifer with curled horns in a black suit, leaning on a pitchfork, one eyebrow raised
shots.motion: Lucifer raises an eyebrow and leans in, smirking

shots.prompt: clay Lucifer holding a campaign poster with his own smiling face and a big red checkmark, hellish background
shots.motion: Lucifer taps the poster and grins, poster wobbles

shots.prompt: clay Lucifer laughing with his head thrown back while the plump man in a suit sinks into bubbling black tar behind him
shots.motion: Lucifer laughs, the man slowly sinks into tar waving his arms
